title: Raucity
summary: RAU'CITY, noun [Latin raucus, hoarse. Raucus is the Eng. rough, which see.] 1. Hoarseness; a loud rough sound; as the raucity of a trumpet. 2. Among physicians, hoarseness of the human voice.
